manifest.author: Prism
manifest.description: Quickly browse and open your Antigravity projects and remote SSH hosts.

zh-Hans.description: 快速浏览并打开 Antigravity 项目和远程 SSH 主机。

antigravityApp.title: Antigravity 应用路径

zh-Hant.name: Antigravity

antigravityApp.title: Antigravity 應用程式路徑

manifest.name: Antigravity

extensions.releaseNotes:
- List Antigravity projects and recently connected remote SSH hosts, sorted by recent conversation activity, with multi-folder badges and the current Git branch shown for local repositories.
- Filter between Local projects and Remote SSH hosts with ⌘P, and open Recent Projects directly from Antigravity’s row in root search with Tab.
- Open Antigravity for local projects, connect directly to remote SSH hosts with `--ssh-host=`, copy the `agy --project` CLI command, reveal project folders in Finder, copy paths, and optionally target Antigravity Insiders or Dev via **Antigravity App Path**.

extensions.releaseNotes:
- A row's second line starts with when the note last changed (the time
  today, then Yesterday, then the date, following the 24-hour and date

manifest.name: Bear

extensions.releaseNotes:
- **Search Bear Notes**: search notes by title, tags, content, or pinyin, filter by Pinned, Todo, Untagged, Locked, or Archived (⌘P), preview Markdown in the detail pane, create a note when nothing matches, and open, copy, archive, or trash notes in Bear.

- **New Note from Clipboard**: create a new Bear note from clipboard text.
- Tab on Bear’s own row in root search opens Search Bear Notes.
- Localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

manifest.author: Prism
manifest.description: Find running apps and processes by CPU or memory usage, and kill or restart them.

zh-Hans.description: 按 CPU 或内存占用查找正在运行的 App 和进程，并结束或重启它们。
zh-Hans.name: 结束进程

closeAfterKill.caption: 结束或重启进程后关闭启动器并显示提示。关闭后列表保持打开并刷新。
closeAfterKill.title: 结束后关闭启动器

zh-Hant.description: 依 CPU 或記憶體用量尋找執行中的 App 與程序，並結束或重新啟動它們。
zh-Hant.name: 結束程序

closeAfterKill.caption: 結束或重新啟動程序後關閉啟動器並顯示提示。關閉後列表會保持開啟並重新載入。

manifest.name: Kill Process

preferences.caption: Close the launcher and show a confirmation after killing or restarting a process. When off, the list stays open and reloads.

extensions.releaseNotes:
- Kill Process lists running apps and processes in a full-width list showing both CPU and memory usage, with ⌘P sorting between CPU Usage and Memory Usage.
- Groups each app bundle’s helper processes under the app by default, with ⇧⌘G to toggle between grouped apps and individual processes.
- Kill, Force Kill, Restart, Force Restart, Kill All, and Force Kill All confirm before signalling and verify process identity (PID and start time) so stale rows never hit reused PIDs.
- Show in Finder and a Copy submenu (path, PID, and `sudo kill` commands for other users’ processes).
- Full Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese translations for the manifest, filters, actions, confirmations, and messages.

extensions.releaseNotes:
